assets.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: scientific-educational rehabilitation exercise photograph, card 158 T-AXU-050 s04 Y-route gentle lift.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the Y-route starting photograph. Make one narrowly scoped change: gently lift BOTH COMPLETE STRAIGHT ARMS away from the mat by approximately 5 to 8 cm while preserving their exact existing symmetrical diagonal Y directions. Keep elbows straight, hands empty, wrists neutral and shoulders relaxed. Both arms rise together as complete connected limbs from upper arm through elbow, forearm, wrist and fingertips: show clear small air gaps and subtle detached soft shadows beneath BOTH upper arms, BOTH elbows, BOTH forearms and BOTH hands. The shoulders remain attached normally to the supported torso; no disconnected arm illusion. This is a low gentle lift, not a high maximal lift.
Preserve the EXACT woman's identity and everything outside the arm lift: same white short-sleeved shirt, dark gray trousers, black ponytail, bare feet, skin tone and natural proportions; same head at the bottom and feet at the top; same exact body location and scale. Keep her forehead firmly supported on the same soft gray head pad, neck neutral, chest and abdomen entirely resting on the mat, pelvis and both legs and feet supported. No raised head, no lifted chest, no arched lower back.
Do not move, rotate, zoom, crop or change the camera, canvas, perspective, mat corners, mat size, background or lighting. Keep the entire original broad gray-blue mat and original wide composition exactly. Arms retain the original s03 image diagonal Y layout with hands down-left and down-right of the head, equal lengths, realistic joints and all fingers visible. Only a small vertical lift with realistic separation shadows distinguishes this image from the start.
Return ONE photorealistic photograph. No text, arrows, digits, border, watermark, montage, inset, props or weights.
